name: RW3_numeric
command: import hashlib,pathlib,subprocess,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2], "test binary changed"; sys.exit(subprocess.call([p]))
